title: BondCraft
description: Recruit monsters, build your party, and explore mysterious worlds in Minecraft.
body:
# BondCraft

Turn your enemies into allies and build your own monster team.

BondCraft is a Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1 mod focused on monster recruitment, party building, exploration, and mysterious world events.

Defeat creatures, obtain Bond Certificates, recruit monsters, and create your own party with unique abilities and type synergies.

Explore the world, discover strange purple portal residues, meet NPCs in the Starting Village, and uncover creatures arriving from unknown dimensions.

---

## Main Features

* Monster recruitment / Bond system
* Party & Bench management
* Unique passive & natural abilities
* Type Synergy system
* Monster evolution system
* NPCs & Bond Coin Shop
* Starting Village generation
* Improved AI & spawning systems
* Purple Portal Residue world events

---

## Current Focus

The Fabric version is now the main development version of BondCraft.

The mod is still actively evolving, and more monsters, systems, world events, and gameplay mechanics are planned for future updates.

---

## Requirements

* Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1
* Fabric API
* GeckoLib
* Java 17

---

## Notes

* Early release version
* Balance and systems may continue to change
* World backup recommended before updating
